summary: PRB is internal/agency review cadence — not the same as MLR approval.

sections.heading: PRB cadence
paragraphs: A Promo Review Board (PRB) round is a structured internal or client-agency review before MLR submission.
bullets: Basic / medium / complex work may use 1–3 PRB rounds in planning tools.
Agency schedules production around client review windows — not instead of them.
PRB readiness does not mean MLR-approved.

tool_cta.label: Practice PRB timing (optional)
tool_cta.hint: Save a scenario on your learning sandbox to see PRB anchors.
